title: A stationary varifold whose planes contain the position vector has n-homogeneous weight (corrected 5.3, step A5)
statement: Let C be an n-varifold on ℝ^N (C : Varifold N n univ) which is stationary in ℝ^N and satisfies p_S(y) = y (i.e. y ∈ S) for C-a.e. (y,S), where p_S = Grassmannian.project S is the orthogonal projection onto S. Then μ_C(s·A) = s^n μ_C(A) for every s > 0 and every set A ⊆ ℝ^N (in ℝ≥0∞: C.weight (s • A) = ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A). This is the corrected form of Simon 5.3.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), C.Stationary → (∀ᵐ z ∂C.measure, Grassmannian.project z.2 z.1 = z.1) → ∀ (s : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < s → C.weight (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A
